checks.name: Passed live result and frozen fixture identity
Required checkpoints and official compiler precheck at each breakpoint
Complete frames, epoch continuity, sequence acknowledgement, and 10 Hz limit
Good quality with non-null source/server and workstation timestamps
Resolved OPC UA symbols have exact IEC mapping and access/type evidence
No writes to PLC outputs or read-group state, regardless of server access flags
A, B, unassigned runout, and assigned misroute observed once
Stop removes command during external encoder coast
Failed-divert abort cannot become a second/successful completion

limitations: No continuous generated-world run or physical deceleration model.
Server exposes 68 intended read-only symbols as writable; runner enforces read-only use. Server-side read-only enforcement is not proven.
